1.text: A supplicant asked for a punishment bound to happen<sup foot_note="228080">1</sup>

footnotes.228080: - In the Hereafter.  Disbelievers had challenged the Prophet (ﷺ) by invoking Allāh to bring on His punishment.  See 8:32.

2.text: To the disbelievers; of it there is no preventer.

3.text: [It is] from Allāh, owner of the ways of ascent.

4.text: The angels and the Spirit [i.e., Gabriel] will ascend to Him during a Day the extent of which is fifty thousand years.

5.text: So be patient with gracious patience.

8.text: On the Day the sky will be like murky oil,<sup foot_note="228081">1</sup>

9.text: And the mountains will be like wool,<sup foot_note="228082">1</sup>

footnotes.228082: - i.e., in the process of disintegration.

10.text: And no friend will ask [anything of] a friend,

11.text: They will be shown each other. The criminal will wish that he could be ransomed from the punishment of that Day by his children

12.text: And his wife and his brother

13.text: And his nearest kindred who shelter him

14.text: And whoever is on earth entirely [so] then it could save him.

15.text: No!<sup foot_note="228083">1</sup> Indeed, it is the Flame [of Hell],

footnotes.228083: - An emphatic refusal meaning "It is not to be."

footnotes.228084: - This refers to the skin of the head or of the body or to the body extremities - which will be burned away.

17.text: It invites he who turned his back [on truth] and went away [from obedience]

21.text: And when good touches him, withholding [of it],

23.text: Those who are constant in their prayer

24.text: And those within whose wealth is a known right<sup foot_note="228085">1</sup>

footnotes.228085: - i.e., a specified share, meaning the obligatory zakāh.

25.text: For the petitioner and the deprived -

26.text: And those who believe in the Day of Recompense

27.text: And those who are fearful of the punishment of their Lord -

28.text: Indeed, the punishment of their Lord is not that from which one is safe -

29.text: And those who guard their private parts

30.text: Except from their wives or those their right hands possess,<sup foot_note="228086">1</sup> for indeed, they are not to be blamed -

31.text: But whoever seeks beyond that, then they are the transgressors -

32.text: And those who are to their trusts and promises attentive

33.text: And those who are in their testimonies upright

34.text: And those who [carefully] maintain their prayer:

35.text: They will be in gardens,<sup foot_note="228087">1</sup> honored.

36.text: So what is [the matter] with those who disbelieve, hastening [from] before you, [O Muḥammad],

37.text: [To sit] on [your] right and [your] left in separate groups?<sup foot_note="228088">1</sup>

footnotes.228088: - They sat at a distance in order to oppose and mock the Prophet (ﷺ), claiming that they would enter Paradise before the believers.

38.text: Does every person among them aspire to enter a garden of pleasure?

39.text: No! Indeed, We have created them from that which they know.<sup foot_note="228089">1</sup>

footnotes.228089: - i.e., a liquid disdained.  So how can they expect to enter Paradise except by the will of their Creator?

40.text: So I swear by the Lord of [all] risings and settings<sup foot_note="228090">1</sup> that indeed We are able

footnotes.228090: - i.e., Allāh (subḥānahu wa taʿālā), who determines the point at which the sun, moon and stars rise and set according to season and every position of observation.

41.text: To replace them with better than them; and We are not to be outdone.

42.text: So leave them to converse vainly and amuse themselves until they meet their Day which they are promised -

43.text: The Day they will emerge from the graves rapidly as if they were, toward an erected idol, hastening.<sup foot_note="228091">1</sup>

footnotes.228091: - i.e., just as they used to race, whenever an idol was newly appointed, to be the first of its worshippers.

44.text: Their eyes humbled, humiliation will cover them. That is the Day which they had been promised.
